title: performance contract
description: The app's performance facts, read by the performance-budgets checker (check-perf-code.mjs). The budgets themselves live in quality-gates.json "perf".

layer.description: The on-device measurement layer (cold start, frame times, storage benchmark, perf log). Declared: every file and every wiring line is required (rules perf-layer, debug-perf-wired). Absent: the app measures nothing on devices yet, and the checker says so in a note.

jsEntryFile.description: The file whose startup function calls markJsEntry(perf.epochMs()) once, inside a function, never at module scope: the root layout (src/app/_layout.tsx) by default.

firstScreenFiles.description: The model hook(s) of the first screen a launch shows, each calling useColdStartMark({ perf, perfLog, label, isReady }) with isReady true once its real data is on screen.

testOnlyEntry.description: The test-only entry (debug-menu-and-test-hooks) that builds the perf log and the debug menu's Performance actions; default src/test-only-entry.ts.

nativeModuleDir.description: The local Expo module that reads the process start time; default modules/process-start.

canvasBudgetExempt.description: Screen files allowed more Skia canvases than perf.skiaCanvasesPerScreenMax, each with the measurement that justifies it.
